problem: Prepare ownership, earlier security, business-purpose and repayment documents when offering a property believed to have no current mortgage debt. Document preparation; no recommendation to mortgage property, maximum borrowing/LVR estimate, classification of mortgage priority, credit-law interpretation or predicted approval.

evidence.summary: Results include business property security lenders and substantial consumer/other-asset intent. The document guide must stay explicitly business-purpose and should be treated as a bounded content experiment.
A lender can accept residential or commercial property as proposed business-loan security.
Releasing business mortgage security requires separate owner/property/representative details.
Property securing a business loan can be exposed if it is not repaid.
